settings.description: Read websites in a private browser. Set it up once; attached agents start it automatically, including after a reboot.

status.stoppedMessage: Setup stopped before finishing. Select Set up browser to retry.

actions.label: Test browser
actions.successMessage: Browser test passed. You can ask an attached agent to browse.

hints.text: Select Set up browser to retry, or Test browser to check the existing installation.
First setup downloads about 313 MB and can take several minutes. You can leave this panel while it runs.
To give an agent access, open its editor in Agents and select Browser in tools. Then ask it to open a website in chat.
